points.K1: 穿前准备：摘首饰、物品留门外、束长发

points.K6: 面屏：盖住前额、下巴和两侧
points.K7: 隔离衣：系活结，遮住日常衣物
points.K8: 手套套在袖口外，手腕封严
points.K9: 双层手套：外层脏了换外层
points.K10: 送风头罩：先系腰带、接好线、调头箍
points.K11: 先开机有风再戴，披肩收进防护服
points.K13: 脱卸原则：从最脏到最干净，方法写进规程
points.K14: 先摘手套：翻着脱，外面不碰皮肤
points.K16: 摘面屏、护目镜：捏头带和镜腿
points.K17: 脱隔离衣、实验服：外面朝里卷起

points.K20: 送风头罩：风机转着摘，摘下再关机

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在缓冲间镜子前，旁边挂着隔离衣
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in an anteroom in front of a mirror, an isolation gown hanging beside it, and greets the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲防护装备的穿戴与脱卸。
overlay: 防护装备的穿戴与脱卸

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰做完实验，捏着手套指尖往下拽
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finishes work and yanks his glove off by the fingertips.
shots.narration: 阿杰做完实验，捏着指尖拽手套。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 脏手套外面的污点溅到他手上和脸上（图示）
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: dots of contamination jump from the glove surface onto his bare hand and face. No text.
shots.narration: 手套外的污染，一下沾到手上脸上。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 王老师拿着流程图走过来
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks over holding a blank flow chart.
shots.narration: 王老师说：穿要讲顺序，脱更要讲。

shots.section_title: 穿前准备：摘首饰、物品留门外、束长发
shots.scene: 首饰、手表、手机、外套、包放进门外储物柜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: rings, a watch, a phone, a coat and a bag placed into a locker outside the lab door. No text.
shots.narration: 首饰手表摘下，手机外套包留门外。
overlay: 穿前准备：摘首饰、物品留门外、束长发

shots.section_title: 穿前准备：摘首饰、物品留门外、束长发
shots.scene: 【实拍】长发束起盘好（训练场景，不拍面部）
shots.prompt_en: A person ties long hair back into a bun before putting on protective equipment. Face not shown.
shots.narration: 长发束起来。

shots.section_title: 备齐装备，合身无破损
shots.scene: 基本三件：实验服、护目镜、手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab coat, safety goggles and gloves laid out as the basic set. No text.
shots.narration: 常规操作：实验服、护目镜、手套。
overlay: 备齐装备，合身无破损

shots.section_title: 备齐装备，合身无破损
shots.scene: 防飞溅加两件：隔离衣、口罩、面屏、手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an isolation gown, a mask, a face shield and gloves laid out together. No text.
shots.narration: 有飞溅风险，再加隔离衣、口罩和面屏。

shots.section_title: 备齐装备，合身无破损
shots.scene: 隔离衣：前襟完整、后开、袖口收紧
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an isolation gown with a closed front, back opening and knitted cuffs. No text.
shots.narration: 隔离衣要前襟完整、后开、袖口收紧。

shots.section_title: 备齐装备，合身无破损
shots.scene: 【实拍】展开隔离衣检查有无撕裂、破洞、系带脱落（训练用隔离衣）
shots.prompt_en: Hands unfold an isolation gown and check it for tears, holes and loose ties.
shots.narration: 穿前查破洞、撕裂、系带，坏了就换。

shots.section_title: 穿脱分区，在缓冲间穿好再进
shots.scene: 缓冲间里一边是穿戴区，一边是脱卸区
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an anteroom split into a clean dressing area and a separate undressing area with a waste bin. No text.
shots.narration: 穿戴区和脱卸区分开。
overlay: 穿脱分区，在缓冲间穿好再进

shots.section_title: 穿脱分区，在缓冲间穿好再进
shots.scene: 脏防护用品碰到干净衣物，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a used gown touching clean clothes on a hanger, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 免得脏的防护用品沾到干净物品。

shots.section_title: 穿脱分区，在缓冲间穿好再进
shots.scene: 在缓冲间穿好，确认无误再推门进实验区
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student finishes dressing in the anteroom and then pushes open the lab door.
shots.narration: 在缓冲间穿好，确认无误再进门。

shots.section_title: 穿戴顺序：口罩护目在前，手套最后
shots.scene: 墙上流程图：帽子、口罩、护目镜、隔离衣、手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wall chart with five steps from cap to mask, goggles, gown and gloves. No text.
shots.narration: 常用顺序：帽子、口罩、护目镜、隔离衣、手套。
overlay: 穿戴顺序：口罩护目在前，手套最后

shots.section_title: 穿戴顺序：口罩护目在前，手套最后
shots.scene: 穿前先洗手
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: hand washing at a sink before the dressing steps begin. No text.
shots.narration: 穿之前，先做手卫生。

shots.section_title: 穿戴顺序：口罩护目在前，手套最后
shots.scene: 基本三件顺序：实验服、护目镜、手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three steps: buttoned lab coat, then goggles, then gloves. No text.
shots.narration: 只穿基本三件：衣、镜、手套。

shots.section_title: 穿戴顺序：口罩护目在前，手套最后
shots.scene: 流程图旁写本单位规程（图标）
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the wall chart beside a procedure book with the lab's own stamp. No text.
shots.narration: 手套最后戴，具体以本单位规程为准。

shots.section_title: 口罩：压鼻夹，贴紧鼻梁面颊
shots.scene: 【实拍】戴医用口罩，耳挂挂好，双手食指按压鼻夹（训练用口罩）
shots.prompt_en: A person puts on a medical mask, hooks the ear loops and presses the nose clip with both index fingers.
shots.narration: 挂好耳挂，双手按压鼻夹。
overlay: 口罩：压鼻夹，贴紧鼻梁面颊

shots.section_title: 口罩：压鼻夹，贴紧鼻梁面颊
shots.scene: 口罩上缘贴紧鼻梁和面颊；防护口罩做密合检查
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a mask edge sealing along the nose bridge and cheeks; a respirator user covers it with both hands to check for leaks. No text.
shots.narration: 贴紧鼻梁面颊；防护口罩要查密合。

shots.section_title: 面屏：盖住前额、下巴和两侧
shots.scene: 【实拍】戴面屏：拉开头带套到脑后，海绵贴在眉上（训练用面屏）
shots.prompt_en: A person stretches the face shield band over the back of the head, the foam resting above the eyebrows.
shots.narration: 面屏头带套到脑后，海绵贴眉上。
overlay: 面屏：盖住前额、下巴和两侧

shots.section_title: 面屏：盖住前额、下巴和两侧
shots.scene: 面屏盖住前额、过下巴、包住两侧
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a face shield covering the forehead, extending below the chin and wrapping the sides of the face. No text.
shots.narration: 盖住前额，过下巴，包住两侧。

shots.section_title: 隔离衣：系活结，遮住日常衣物
shots.scene: 【实拍】穿隔离衣，颈后系带、腰带在背后系活结（训练用隔离衣）
shots.prompt_en: A person puts on an isolation gown and ties the neck and waist ties at the back in a bow.
shots.narration: 隔离衣颈后、腰后系好，打活结。
overlay: 隔离衣：系活结，遮住日常衣物

shots.section_title: 隔离衣：系活结，遮住日常衣物
shots.scene: 死结和勒太紧打叉，日常衣物露出也打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tight knot crossed out, and street clothes showing below the gown also crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别打死结、别勒紧，日常衣物不外露。

shots.section_title: 手套套在袖口外，手腕封严
shots.scene: 【实拍】袖口拉到掌心，手套口套在袖口外面（训练用服装）
shots.prompt_en: A person pulls the gown cuff down to the palm and stretches the glove cuff over the sleeve.
shots.narration: 袖口拉到掌心，手套套在袖口外。
overlay: 手套套在袖口外，手腕封严

shots.section_title: 手套套在袖口外，手腕封严
shots.scene: 手套塞在袖子里打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glove tucked inside the sleeve with the cuff exposed, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不是塞进袖子里，袖口不外露。

shots.section_title: 手套套在袖口外，手腕封严
shots.scene: 连体防护服手腕处按规程封严
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the wrist seam between a coverall sleeve and the inner glove sealed according to procedure. No text.
shots.narration: 穿连体服的，手腕缝隙按规程封严。

shots.section_title: 手套套在袖口外，手腕封严
shots.scene: 开工前再查一遍手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks her gloves once more before starting work.
shots.narration: 开工前，再查一遍手套有没有破口。

shots.section_title: 双层手套：外层脏了换外层
shots.scene: 内层手套盖袖口，外层手套再戴一层
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an inner glove over the cuff, then an outer glove pulled on over it. No text.
shots.narration: 风险较高时戴两层，外层最后戴。
overlay: 双层手套：外层脏了换外层

shots.section_title: 双层手套：外层脏了换外层
shots.scene: 外层沾污，在实验室内脱掉换新，内层不动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stained outer glove removed inside the lab and replaced while the inner glove stays on. No text.
shots.narration: 外层脏了只换外层，内层一直护手。

shots.section_title: 双层手套：外层脏了换外层
shots.scene: 手套破了：柜内脱下，手消毒，换新；手破皮报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a torn glove removed in the cabinet, hands disinfected, new gloves on; a skin cut leads to a report icon. No text.
shots.narration: 手套破了立即换；手破皮按暴露报告。

shots.section_title: 送风头罩：先系腰带、接好线、调头箍
shots.scene: 送风头罩电池挂在腰带上，先系腰带
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a battery pack on a belt fastened around the waist before putting on a coverall. No text.
shots.narration: 戴送风头罩：先系好腰带，调好松紧。
overlay: 送风头罩：先系腰带、接好线、调头箍

shots.section_title: 送风头罩：先系腰带、接好线、调头箍
shots.scene: 穿上防护服后够不着腰带（图示）
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person in a coverall unable to reach the belt underneath, with a question mark. No text.
shots.narration: 穿上防护服，就够不着了。

shots.section_title: 送风头罩：先系腰带、接好线、调头箍
shots.scene: 导线插紧拧牢，头箍调到合适
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a breathing hose connected and twisted tight, and the headband inside the hood adjusted. No text.
shots.narration: 导线插紧拧牢，头箍调到稳稳贴额。

shots.section_title: 先开机有风再戴，披肩收进防护服
shots.scene: 先开机，伸手在头罩里感觉有风
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the blower switched on and a hand inside the hood feeling the airflow. No text.
shots.narration: 戴之前一定先开机，有风再戴。
overlay: 先开机有风再戴，披肩收进防护服

shots.section_title: 先开机有风再戴，披肩收进防护服
shots.scene: 没开机就戴头罩，憋闷打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person wearing a hood with the blower off, gasping, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不送风就戴，会憋闷，有窒息危险。

shots.section_title: 先开机有风再戴，披肩收进防护服
shots.scene: 风机转着戴上头罩，披肩拉平盖住肩膀
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: with the blower running the hood is pulled on and the shoulder cape smoothed flat. No text.
shots.narration: 风机转着戴上，披肩拉平不卷边。

shots.section_title: 先开机有风再戴，披肩收进防护服
shots.scene: 披肩和管线塞进防护服，拉好拉链系紧颈部
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the hood cape and hose tucked into the coverall, zipper closed and neck fastened. No text.
shots.narration: 披肩管线收进防护服，拉好拉链。

shots.section_title: 先开机有风再戴，披肩收进防护服
shots.scene: 进门前看指示灯全亮
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: all indicator lights on the blower glowing before entering; one light off means stop. No text.
shots.narration: 指示灯全亮再进门，不全就别进。

shots.section_title: 照镜自查，同伴互查
shots.scene: 【实拍】穿好后对镜检查：头面部、拉链、手腕、脚下（训练用服装，不拍面部）
shots.prompt_en: A person in training protective clothing checks the head area, zipper, wrists and feet in a mirror. Face not shown.
shots.narration: 穿完照镜子：头面、拉链、手腕、脚下。
overlay: 照镜自查，同伴互查

shots.section_title: 照镜自查，同伴互查
shots.scene: 小研帮阿杰查看背后和颈部
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks the back and neck of the young male student's gown.
shots.narration: 镜子看不到背后，请同伴互查。

shots.section_title: 照镜自查，同伴互查
shots.scene: 先练熟、经考核，再进实验室
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: practice sessions, a passed assessment and then entry to the lab. No text.
shots.narration: 先练熟、经考核，再进实验室。

shots.section_title: 脱卸原则：从最脏到最干净，方法写进规程
shots.scene: 防护用品外面红色、里面绿色，从最红的开始脱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: protective items with red outer surfaces and green inner surfaces; removal starts with the reddest item, the gloves. No text.
shots.narration: 脱卸从最脏的开始，到最干净的结束。
overlay: 脱卸原则：从最脏到最干净，方法写进规程

shots.section_title: 脱卸原则：从最脏到最干净，方法写进规程
shots.scene: 墙上脱卸流程：手套、手消毒、护目镜、隔离衣、口罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wall chart for undressing in five steps from gloves to hand hygiene, goggles, gown and mask. No text.
shots.narration: 常用顺序：手套、手消毒、护目、隔离衣、口罩。

shots.section_title: 脱卸原则：从最脏到最干净，方法写进规程
shots.scene: 脏面朝里，一件一件脱，不碰身体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: each item peeled off with the dirty side turned inward, away from the body. No text.
shots.narration: 一件一件脱，脏面朝里，别碰身上。

shots.section_title: 脱卸原则：从最脏到最干净，方法写进规程
shots.scene: 实验室选定一种脱法，写进规程统一做
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two removal methods, one chosen and written into the lab procedure book for everyone. No text.
shots.narration: 脱法选定一种，写进规程，别临场乱换。

shots.section_title: 先摘手套：翻着脱，外面不碰皮肤
shots.scene: 【实拍】一只手捏住另一只手套腕部外侧（训练用手套）
shots.prompt_en: One gloved hand pinches the outside of the other glove at the wrist.
shots.narration: 先摘手套：捏住腕部外侧。
overlay: 先摘手套：翻着脱，外面不碰皮肤

shots.section_title: 先摘手套：翻着脱，外面不碰皮肤
shots.scene: 【实拍】整只拉下翻成里朝外，握在戴手套的手里（训练用手套）
shots.prompt_en: The glove is peeled off inside out and held in the palm of the still-gloved hand.
shots.narration: 整只拉下翻过来，握在另一手心。

shots.section_title: 先摘手套：翻着脱，外面不碰皮肤
shots.scene: 【实拍】裸手手指从手腕内侧伸进去，向外翻下，两只包成一团（训练用手套）
shots.prompt_en: Bare fingers slide under the inner wrist of the remaining glove and peel it off over the first one.
shots.narration: 裸手从内侧伸进，翻下包成一团。

shots.section_title: 先摘手套：翻着脱，外面不碰皮肤
shots.scene: 干净的手不碰手套外面；手套丢进感染性废物袋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bare hand never touching the glove's outer surface; the bundle dropped into a biohazard bin. No text.
shots.narration: 裸手不碰外面，丢进感染性废物袋。

shots.section_title: 摘手套后先手消毒
shots.scene: 【实拍】摘手套后取速干手消毒剂揉搓双手（训练场景）
shots.prompt_en: After removing gloves, a person rubs hands with alcohol-based hand rub.
shots.narration: 摘完手套，先做手卫生。
overlay: 摘手套后先手消毒

shots.section_title: 摘手套后先手消毒
shots.scene: 手消毒或洗手，或换一副干净手套再继续脱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three options after removing gloves: hand rub, hand washing, or a fresh pair of gloves before continuing. No text.
shots.narration: 按规程手消毒或洗手，再脱下一件。

shots.section_title: 摘面屏、护目镜：捏头带和镜腿
shots.scene: 【实拍】头稍前倾，捏耳上方头带轻轻摘下面屏（训练用面屏）
shots.prompt_en: Head tilted slightly forward, a person lifts the face shield off by the band above the ears.
shots.narration: 摘面屏：头前倾，捏头带轻轻提起。
overlay: 摘面屏、护目镜：捏头带和镜腿

shots.section_title: 摘面屏、护目镜：捏头带和镜腿
shots.scene: 面屏前片污染，手碰前片打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the front of the face shield marked as contaminated; a hand touching it crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别碰前片，一次性的丢进废物袋。

shots.section_title: 摘面屏、护目镜：捏头带和镜腿
shots.scene: 捏住太阳穴处镜腿摘护目镜，放到消毒盘
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: goggles removed by the arms at the temples and placed in a disinfection tray. No text.
shots.narration: 护目镜捏镜腿摘，放指定处统一消毒。

shots.section_title: 脱隔离衣、实验服：外面朝里卷起
shots.scene: 【实拍】解开腰带，抓住两肩向前拉，颈后系带松开（训练用隔离衣）
shots.prompt_en: A person unties the waist tie, grasps the gown at both shoulders and pulls forward to release the neck tie.
shots.narration: 脱隔离衣：解腰带，抓两肩往前拉。
overlay: 脱隔离衣、实验服：外面朝里卷起

shots.section_title: 脱隔离衣、实验服：外面朝里卷起
shots.scene: 【实拍】从肩部往前脱、远离身体，边脱边卷，外面翻到里面（训练用隔离衣）
shots.prompt_en: The gown is pulled away from the body and rolled up inside out as it comes off.
shots.narration: 离身往前脱，边脱边卷，外面朝里。

shots.section_title: 脱隔离衣、实验服：外面朝里卷起
shots.scene: 裸手不碰实验服外面，捏袖口内侧抽出手臂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bare hand pinches the clean inner cuff of the lab coat to slide the arm out, never touching the outside. No text.
shots.narration: 实验服：裸手不碰外面，捏袖口抽臂。

shots.section_title: 脱隔离衣、实验服：外面朝里卷起
shots.scene: 可再穿的挂指定处，污染的卷团丢弃
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reusable lab coat hung on a designated hook; a contaminated one rolled up and put into a biohazard bin. No text.
shots.narration: 可再穿的挂好，污染的卷起丢弃。

shots.section_title: 另两种做法：连手套一起脱，或先衣后手套
shots.scene: 手套连同袖口一起剥下，留在袖子里
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: while pulling the arms out, the gloves are peeled off together with the sleeves and stay inside them. No text.
shots.narration: 另一做法：手套连袖口一起剥下。
overlay: 另两种做法：连手套一起脱，或先衣后手套

shots.section_title: 另两种做法：连手套一起脱，或先衣后手套
shots.scene: 衣带手套里朝外卷成一团丢弃
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the gown and gloves rolled into one inside-out bundle and dropped into a biohazard bin. No text.
shots.narration: 衣带手套卷成一团，脏面不碰身。

shots.section_title: 另两种做法：连手套一起脱，或先衣后手套
shots.scene: 先脱隔离衣，袖子从手套下抽出，再摘手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the gown sleeves slide out from under the gloves first, then the gloves are removed. No text.
shots.narration: 也有先脱隔离衣、再摘手套的。

shots.section_title: 摘口罩：只捏耳挂
shots.scene: 【实拍】只捏耳挂摘下口罩，不碰口罩外面（训练用口罩）
shots.prompt_en: A person removes a mask by holding only the ear loops, not touching the front.
shots.narration: 最后摘口罩：只捏耳挂，不碰外面。
overlay: 摘口罩：只捏耳挂

shots.section_title: 摘口罩：只捏耳挂
shots.scene: 口罩离开面部直接丢进废物袋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the mask moved away from the face and dropped straight into a biohazard bin. No text.
shots.narration: 离开面部就丢进感染性废物袋。

shots.section_title: 送风头罩：风机转着摘，摘下再关机
shots.scene: 风机转着摘头罩，外面当作污染
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the hood lifted off while the blower keeps running; its outer surface shaded as contaminated. No text.
shots.narration: 摘头罩时风机别关，外面都当污染。
overlay: 送风头罩：风机转着摘，摘下再关机

shots.section_title: 送风头罩：风机转着摘，摘下再关机
shots.scene: 手只碰规定位置，脸不碰外面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: hands holding only the marked grip points of the hood, the face kept away from its outer surface. No text.
shots.narration: 手只碰规定位置，脸别碰外面。

shots.section_title: 送风头罩：风机转着摘，摘下再关机
shots.scene: 摘下放指定处去污，再关机拔电池
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the hood placed in a decontamination area, then the blower switched off and the battery removed. No text.
shots.narration: 放到指定处去污，再关机、拔电池。

shots.section_title: 最后洗手，再离开
shots.scene: 【实拍】流水洗手：搓手背、指缝、指尖（演示）
shots.prompt_en: Hands are washed with soap under running water, rubbing backs, between fingers and fingertips.
shots.narration: 最后用流水和洗手液认真洗手。
overlay: 最后洗手，再离开

shots.section_title: 最后洗手，再离开
shots.scene: 纸巾擦干，用纸巾关水龙头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: hands dried with a paper towel, which is then used to turn off the tap. No text.
shots.narration: 纸巾擦干，再用纸巾关龙头。

shots.section_title: 最后洗手，再离开
shots.scene: 暂时没水先用手消毒剂，有水尽快洗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: alcohol hand rub used when no sink is nearby, followed later by hand washing. No text.
shots.narration: 暂时没水先手消，有条件尽快洗手。

shots.section_title: 最后洗手，再离开
shots.scene: 阿杰洗完手走出实验室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student washes his hands and walks out of the lab.
shots.narration: 洗完手，再离开实验室。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 穿：帽子、口罩、护目镜、隔离衣、手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: five dressing steps in order with check marks. No text.
shots.narration: 穿：先准备检查，手套最后戴。
overlay: 小结

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 脱：手套、手消毒、护目镜、隔离衣、口罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: five undressing steps in order with check marks. No text.
shots.narration: 脱：从最脏到最干净，脏面朝里。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 洗手、规程、互查三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons for hand washing, a procedure book and a buddy check. No text.
shots.narration: 按本单位规程，互查练熟，最后洗手。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣举着消毒剂瓶挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a disinfectant bottle and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：消毒与灭菌。
